purpose: Authorize only the protected critical-path work required to import, validate, canary, and activate the validated compiler corpus for students.

compiler.required_source: the validated Wave 106 branch tip reported at completion

adaptive_platform.required_first_action: reconcile the ownership/ontology work on main with launch hardening in an isolated branch; stop if either history cannot be preserved

requested_authority.limits: Only the 1,275 validated questions, 27 diagnostics, their reviewed ontology mappings, import journals, and activation state; no unrelated curriculum or student-history mutation.

write_import: questions: insert inactive records and update only compiler provenance/projection fields for the exact imported revision
curriculum_import_items: new append-only per-revision identity, checksum, outcome, retry, and rollback journal
write_activation: questions: serving_eligible and is_active only after all gates pass
assessments: is_active only after all gates pass

changes: add source_system, source_question_id, source_revision, source_content_sha256 and import_batch_id to questions
add a unique idempotency index over source_system, source_question_id, source_revision
enforce same-revision checksum conflicts and inactive/not-serving defaults
retain and build upon migration 039 ontology projection columns

canonical_mutation_scope.population: exactly 1,275 validated question revisions and 27 diagnostic assessments after human review
forbidden: infer live exposure from repository activation

adaptive_platform_files_or_services: backend/scripts/import_compiler_package.py (new operator-only command; no public import endpoint)
backend/app/core/question_grading.py and bounded adapters required for exact 14-capability parity
backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/topics.py, attempts.py, curriculum.py, and assessments.py only where fail-closed capability/serving/ownership gates require changes
backend/tests for importer, migration, capability parity, ownership, retrieval, submission, grading, retry and rollback
deployment configuration for a disabled-by-default compiler corpus feature flag

identity_and_authorization.publisher: distinct reviewed principal with curriculum_publisher role
identity_and_authorization.student: approved Clerk subject with one unique internal users.id mapping
rules: do not expose importer or publisher operations through student routes

student_visible_effects: approved students may retrieve newly activated questions through existing topic and curriculum practice routes
approved students may submit answers and receive grading results through existing attempt/practice/assessment routes
activation expands available course/question coverage; it does not authorize new performance tracking

activation_sequence.name: canonical promotion and inactive production import

rollback: disable student serving before any compensating data operation
set imported questions serving_eligible=false and is_active=false by import batch
restore the prior serving revision when one exists
retain question attempts, assessment responses, progress, import journal, and canonical history
verify retrieval returns no rolled-back revision and existing student history remains readable
validation_and_audit: migration forward/rollback rehearsal on an isolated production-shaped database
1,275 identity, checksum, provenance, lineage and count proof
all 14 answer capabilities graded through adaptive APIs with no fallback
duplicate, conflict, transient retry and permanent rejection proof
authenticated ownership and cross-user rejection proof
full compiler and adaptive suites plus Git-less compiler clean room
staging end-to-end retrieval, submission, grading and rollback
independent security, data-integrity and student-safety audit
bounded canary with explicit rollback owner
stop_conditions: either repository baseline drifts before its work begins
adaptive main and launch-hardening histories cannot be reconciled without dropping validated protection
any question, assessment, identity, lineage, checksum, provenance or ontology count differs
any of the 14 answer capabilities lacks exact fail-closed adaptive grading behavior
migration or rollback is not atomic and repeatable
an importer, publisher or student ownership boundary can be bypassed
student serving can become active before separate approval
any full, clean-room, staging, restart or rollback gate fails
student attempt or progress history would be deleted or rewritten
a new external dependency or material architecture redesign becomes necessary
